# judo-sdk-common

> Base classes and interfaces that generated JUDO SDK source code depends on at runtime — defines entity identity, map-based payload conversion, DAO base class, and a type-safe query filter framework.

Key facts:
- Java 21, single-module Maven project with OSGi bundle packaging
- Build tool: Maven 3.9.4 with Maven Wrapper (`mvnw`)
- Core dependencies: Eclipse EMF, judo-dao-api, judo-meta-asm (Architecture Specific Model)
- Packaged as an OSGi bundle exporting `hu.blackbelt.judo.sdk*`
- Testing: JUnit 5, Mockito 4, Hamcrest 2, JaCoCo for coverage
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0)

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, architecture diagrams, and build commands

## Source — Core Layer

- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/AbstractSdkDao.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/AbstractSdkDao.java): Abstract base class for all generated SDK DAOs; wires DAO, AsmModel, and PayloadValidator
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/Identifiable.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/Identifiable.java): Entity identity contract — identifier, entity type, version, and type adaptation
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/MapHolder.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/MapHolder.java): Contract for objects convertible to Map<String, Object> (the DAO payload format)
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/SdkUtil.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/SdkUtil.java): Static helpers for entity-to-map conversion and EMF EReference resolution
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/Enumeration.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/Enumeration.java): Contract for generated enum types with name, ordinal, and fully qualified name
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/NamedElement.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/NamedElement.java): Simple interface for elements with a display name

## Source — Query Filter Framework

- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/query/Filter.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/query/Filter.java): Base filter interface producing expression strings via Operation patterns
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/query/Operation.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/query/Operation.java): Defines getPattern() returning a MessageFormat pattern string
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/query/StringFilter.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/query/StringFilter.java): String comparisons plus matches, like, and ilike operations
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/query/NumberFilter.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/query/NumberFilter.java): Numeric comparisons (==, !=, <, >, <=, >=)
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/query/BooleanFilter.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/query/BooleanFilter.java): Boolean predicates (isTrue, isFalse)
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/query/DateFilter.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/query/DateFilter.java): Date comparisons using LocalDate
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/query/TimeFilter.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/query/TimeFilter.java): Time comparisons using LocalTime
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/query/TimestampFilter.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/query/TimestampFilter.java): Timestamp comparisons using LocalDateTime/OffsetDateTime (normalized to UTC)
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/query/EnumerationFilter.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/sdk/query/EnumerationFilter.java): Enum equality/inequality using fully qualified names
